group list.stdout:
Usage: neri group list [OPTIONS] {target_id}

Arguments:
  target_id  [required]

Options:
  --limit <int range>             [default: 40; 1<=x<=100]
  --cursor <str>
  --search <str>
  --class-key <str>
  --filter <all|active|attention|awaiting_review|reviewed_findings|reviewed_no_findings>
  --include-empty / --no-include-empty
                                  [default: no-include-empty]
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
